_meta.purpose: Machine-readable contract for the universal per-microservice flat layout mandated by ADR-0131. Read by the oya-governance-per-microservice-layout CI lane to refuse out-of-layout artifacts and by the oya-governance-aggregation-index-generation lane to regenerate central indices from per-microservice sources of truth.

scope.applies_to: every microservice and every product in the oyatie repo, without exception

central_locations_reserved_for_cross_cut.scope: cross-cutting ADRs only (decisions that govern multiple microservices or the repo as a whole)
cross-cutting standards: code style, commit message, API design, schema migration, error handling, observability/SLO authoring rules
authoring templates: PRD, ADR, IP, phase-spec, runbook, etc.

cross-cutting machine-readable specs: masterplan.json, master-plan-sequencing.json, hyperscaler-gates.json, per-microservice-flat-layout.json, agentic-slo-gated-promotion.json. Per-microservice specs move to microservices/<ms>/specs/
workspace manifest; [workspace.members] lists per-microservice crate paths
CI workflows (GitHub Actions requires workflows at .github/workflows/; nested locations are not picked up)

aggregation indices and append-only ledgers (promotion-eligibility.jsonl, changeset state, etc.). Per-crate catalog rows live at microservices/<ms>/catalog/; registry/catalog/ becomes a generated aggregation.
per-jurisdiction packs span multiple microservices; unified under packs/<jurisdiction>/{localization,compliance,sovereignty}/ per F-0016 consolidation; retained as cross-cutting
repo-wide evidence stores (goals, pr-reviews, etc. that span microservices). Per-microservice evidence lives at microservices/<ms>/evidence/
